audit.why: Ornn at 1 and at 6, Akali from 3 and from first item, matches 48.64% Emerald+ over 2747 games and both on-disk charts. Charts untouched.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes read 'Volcanic Rupture online, level 6, first item' with no numbers and gave Akali 'levels 2-3'.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud is not learnable before level 3. Ornn's real early spike is Bellows Breath at level 2 - Brittle is what makes his trades win - and his level-6 spike is Call of the Forge God on 140/120/100s from 2500 range, which knocks up twice and re-applies Brittle.
audit.corrected: breakdown.spikes, phases[4].why and content whys[6] rebuilt on Brittle, level 3 and the 140s ultimate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every 'track this' line in the full layer points at Volcanic Rupture and describes it as 'Wall-knockup setup', and Brittle is named nowhere in the full layer at all.
audit.why: Volcanic Rupture only makes the pillar; the knockup comes from Searing Charge colliding with terrain, so the ability to stand away from is his E and the walls, not his Q. And the actual trade-decider is Bellows Breath (12/11.5/11/10.5/10s): it applies Brittle, and any immobilising effect he lands on a Brittle target becomes a stun. The content layer says this correctly and the full layer never mentions it, so the two halves of the page disagree about what loses you the lane.
audit.corrected: tldr, report[0].t, winCon, report[1].t, enemyWin, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0], dosFull[2], report[5].t, dontsFull[0].t, dontsFull[1].d, report[9].t, report[11].t and phases[1].why now key on Bellows Breath and Brittle.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown appeared anywhere in the entry.
audit.why: Bellows Breath 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s, Volcanic Rupture 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s, Searing Charge 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s and Call of the Forge God 140/120/100s. The 12s on Bellows Breath is the one that turns 'commit when his W is down' from a slogan into a plan.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, winCon, report[1].t and report[9].t now carry them.

audit.why: Magic pen is right and stated: Living Forge gives Ornn bonus armour AND magic resist from every source, so raw damage stacking loses to him faster than penetration does. Left alone.

notes: Ornn's kit file flags Volcanic Rupture (Q) as 'grounding'. Riot's description says damage, slow and a magma pillar only, so I wrote nothing claiming his Q can deny Shuriken Flip or Perfect Execution. The full layer had also mis-assigned the knockup to Q; it comes from Searing Charge colliding with terrain, which is why the 'don't stand near walls' advice belongs to his E.
